repository.name: @webex/internal-plugin-search
repository.purpose: Internal plugin registered as webex.internal.search for the search service (catalog name argonaut). people() POSTs a directory query and resolves the response body; search() binds a user KMS key on first use (bindSearchKey, one-flight), stores its URL as searchEncryptionKeyUrl on the device, and POSTs an activity search whose query an outbound payload transform encrypts, while an inbound predicate hands the activities to the conversation plugin's transform for decryption; with includeRemoteClusterReferences it appends activities fetched from remote clusters. It stores nothing itself.

commands.unit-test: [NEEDS HUMAN INPUT] -- package.json defines no test:unit script and the package has no test/unit directory; its only spec, test/integration/spec/search.js, is wrapped in xdescribe and runs only under test:browser, which currently bundles nothing. Add a unit suite and script before recording a command here.

public_interfaces.name: @webex/internal-plugin-search package entry
public_interfaces.notes: Importing the package imports the conversation and encryption plugins, then registers Search as internal plugin 'search' with config {search: {}} and the payload predicates encryptSearchQuery (outbound) and transformObjectArray (inbound) plus the outbound transform encryptSearchQuery; the first registration of the name wins. The default export is the only export.

public_interfaces.name: webex.internal.search methods
public_interfaces.notes: people resolves the directory response body and rejects without query or queryString; search binds a search key on first use, sends the query encrypted, and resolves an array of decrypted activities, adding remote-cluster activities with includeRemoteClusterReferences. Both methods modify the caller's options object.
